media.title: Berlin Years — document gallery
media.description: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual sources relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Berlin years, including directory evidence and German film-periodical materials.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s Berlin years, combining documents, press items and film-periodical sources.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual sources relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Berlin years, including directory evidence and German film-periodical materials.
media.rightsNote: Rights are stated on each item in this gallery, not on the gallery as a whole. It gathers documents under different terms: some are public domain or served under the reuse terms of the holding institution, and 4 are reproduced at reduced resolution with rights uncleared. Follow the item to read its own statement.
media.publicCreditLine: Credits are given on each item. The gallery gathers material from the Deutsches Zeitungsportal of the Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek, ANNO of the Österreichische Nationalbibliothek, Polona of the Biblioteka Narodowa, the ZLB digital collections and the Internet Archive.

timelineEvents.title: Bick & Kaper at Berlin premiere
timelineEvents.label: 1929 · Bick & Kaper at Berlin premiere
timelineEvents.shortDescription: The Bick und Kaper piano duo plays at a Berlin film premiere and attracts press attention.
timelineEvents.longDescription: The jazz piano duo Bick und Kaper performs at the Ufa-Theater "Universum" in Berlin, opening the premiere of "Der Adjutant des Zaren." The Rhein- und Ruhrzeitung writes: "Their technique is astonishing."

places.publicNote: Historic cinema site at Kurfürstendamm 153, connected with the 1929 Bick & Kaper appearance at the premiere of Der Adjutant des Zaren. The marker identifies the documented venue site, not a position within the former auditorium.
